messages.subject: Change point Models
parts:
Hi Ratan's users,

I run my model on change point. My running has run one day to a small data. So I think I have a problem in my model.

I have a data PxQ, including in each NA. P = 50 and 
So I calculate a vector which counts the observations in each line : N_WoNA. So for each line, Q isn't the because, because NA are different, each valeur of N_WoNA is from 1 to Q.
 
I construct the vector y which takes all observations per line, as similar to Sparse and ranged Data Structure on page 150.

So, could you help me what I change to perform my model please

Bests Eric I. EBOULET
// Change Detection
data { 
  int<lower=1> P;         // Number of subjects 
  int<lower=1> Q;         // Number of columns
  int<lower=1> N;         // length of observations without NA
  int<lower=1> N_WoNA[P]; // Number of observations without NA per line (Values of N_WoNA are differents)
  int<lower=1> pp[N];     // index of subjects
  vector[N] y;            // vector d'observations regitreted per subjects, per line
}

transformed data {
  vector[P] log_unif;     // vector -log(N_WoNA) to each number of observations without NA per line
  
  for(p in 1:P){
    log_unif[p] = -log(N_WoNA[p]);
  }
}

parameters {
  matrix[P,2] mu;                  // each line has 2 means
  real<lower=0,upper=N> lambda[P]; // each line has a same standard deviation - precision
} 

transformed parameters { I think I do a false here
  real<lower=0> sigma[P];         // vector standard deviation
  matrix[P,Q] lp;                 // log probability PxQ 

  
  for (p in 1:P)
    sigma[p] = inv_sqrt(lambda[p]);
  
  lp = rep_matrix(log_unif, Q);
  for (n in 1:N)
    for (s in 1:N_WoNA[pp[n]])
      for (i in 1:N_WoNA[pp[n]])
        lp[pp[n],s] = lp[pp[n],s] + normal_lpdf(y[n] | i < s ? mu[pp[n],1] : mu[pp[n],2] , sigma[pp[n]]);
}

// So lp is matrix PxQ but I don't use all observations in matrix, because for each line or each p (p=1,...,P), I use from index 1 to index N_WoNA[p]  and N_WoNA[p] isn't always Q. So I take this hypothesis in model. I construct vector vec_lp to obtenir the observations needed.

model { 
  // Group Means
  to_row_vector(mu) ~ normal(0, 5);
  // Common Precision
  lambda ~ gamma(0.001, 0.001);

  // Which Side is Time of Change Point?
  // Data Come From A Gaussian
  for (p in 1:P){
    vector[N_WoNA[p]] vec_lp;
    vec_lp = rep_vector(0,N_WoNA[p]);
    for (i in 1:N_WoNA[p]){
      vec_lp[i] = lp[p,i];
    }
    target += log_sum_exp(vec_lp);
  }
}

generated quantities {
  int<lower=1> s[P];
  
  for (p in 1:P){
    vector[N_WoNA[p]] vec_lp;
    vec_lp = rep_vector(0,N_WoNA[p]);
    for (i in 1:N_WoNA[p]){
      vec_lp[i] = lp[p,i];
    }
    s[p] = categorical_rng(softmax(vec_lp));  
  }
}
